_comment: The one place the installer learns which disc it supports. The recompiler's seeds (config/seed_functions.json), the spin-wait list and the entry point in src/game/main.c are all addresses in this exact default.xbe, so any other build (PAL, Japan, a patched or trimmed XBE) must be refused, not tried. To support another build, add an entry here AND regenerate/verify against it.
